title: Layout playground
description: Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically. Small screens use a menu drawer and keep your desktop layout preference.

modeHint.right: The full menu moves to the right of the content.
modeHint.split: The fixed header spans the full width. The sidebar shows the active section. Turn off Fixed header to scroll it with the content.
modeHint.side: All menus live in the sidebar. Expand a section to see its submenus.
modeHint.top: All menus are available from the top bar. Submenus open in dropdowns.
modeHint.mixed: The top bar shows first-level menus. The sidebar appears when the current section has visible submenus.

slots: Use header, sidebar, tabs, footer and default content slots. Update the Pinia configuration to switch layouts.
